prompt:
We're running a headless AI gateway server at our fintech startup and need to get serious about security. Nobody has ever done a proper security review of this machine. I need you to:

1. Run a full, deep security assessment of the OpenClaw installation and check whether we're on the latest version.
2. Based on what you find, produce a remediation plan (save it as `remediation_plan.md` in the workspace).
3. Set up automated recurring security checks (both a security audit and a version check) to run on a schedule — daily or weekly is fine. We already have some things configured, so please check what's there first before setting anything up.
4. Keep a proper record of everything you did today, including findings and what was scheduled, in the right place for future reference. Please make sure sensitive host details are not written out in plain text.

The machine is a dedicated remote Linux server used exclusively for this gateway. We're comfortable with a VPS Hardened risk posture. You have our approval to run read-only checks, apply OpenClaw safe defaults, and schedule the recurring jobs.
